The '''Pak-It Gear Bag''' was a brand of [[gear bag]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It cost fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy.<ref name="PSG" />
